name: director
title_zh: 从一句话到成片，三个已验证视频模式全流程导演
tagline_zh: 故事动画、解说动画、剧情片三套已验证流程，从创意研究到分镜生成再到素材交付，全程有人盯进度。不靠感觉拍片。
tagline_en: Three battle-tested modes—storytime, explainer, drama—that carry you from premise to storyboard to delivered.
desc_en: 导演并制作多类型视频，从创意、研究、剧本、视觉开发、人物与声音设计、分镜和生成 Prompt，一直推进到素材生成、任务追踪与交付。适用于 Storytime Animation、Animated Explainer 与 Cinematic Drama，三个 Mode 均已完成实际作品验证。尚未建立专属 Mode 的类型不得冒充已支持流程。
why_zh: 不是生成单个片段，而是把导演拆成可执行工序：每一步都有明确产物，素材生成与任务追踪闭环。
why_en: It doesn't just generate clips—it decomposes directing into executable stages with tangible outputs, closing the loop between.
limit_en: Only supports Storytime Animation, Animated Explainer, and Cinematic Drama. Requires an environment with image/video gen models. Does not perform.
title_en: Direct three video types from idea to final cut
